description: This file defines the 'Channel' class within the WPEFramework::PluginHost namespace, which extends WebSocket link functionality for handling WebSocket communication, including JSON and text message processing, request handling, and connection state management. It also includes nested classes for packaging data and serializing/deserializing JSON content.

classes.name: Channel
classes.description: A class extending WebSocket link type to manage WebSocket connections, message serialization/deserialization, and request handling within the WPEFramework plugin host environment.

classes.name: Package
classes.description: A helper class for packaging JSON or text data to be sent over the WebSocket connection.

classes.name: SerializerImpl
classes.description: Handles serialization of JSON elements for outbound messages.

classes.name: DeserializerImpl
classes.description: Handles deserialization of incoming data streams into JSON elements.

methods.name: Channel
methods.description: Constructor initializing the channel with a socket connector and remote node ID.

methods.description: Checks if the channel has activity, and sends a ping if it is a WebSocket with no recent activity.

methods.name: Name
methods.description: Returns the name of the channel based on its path.

methods.name: Id
methods.description: Returns the unique identifier of the channel.

methods.name: State
methods.description: Returns the current state of the channel.

methods.name: IsNotified
methods.description: Checks if the channel has notification flag set.

methods.description: Enqueues a string message for sending.

methods.description: Enqueues a JSON element for sending.

methods.description: Enqueues a Web::Response for sending.

methods.description: Locks the channel for thread safety.

methods.name: Properties

methods.name: State
methods.description: Sets the state of the channel with optional notification flag.

methods.description: Serializes data for transmission based on current state.

methods.name: Deserialize
